scenario.name: Public chatbot discovery baseline
scenario.objective: Send a harmless support question through a publicly accessible chatbot and capture the observable response
scenario.description: The browser layer must discover the chat interface without provider-specific locators.
scenario.expectedBehavior: The public chat accepts the question and produces an observable response.

finishConditions.description: A non-empty bot response is captured after the message is submitted.

expectedIntent: Answer the user's support question using the chatbot's available knowledge.
